name: Qualcomm Technologies
old_description: Qualcomm is a semiconductor and telecommunications equipment company based in California. Designs and supplies chips and modems for mobile phones and wireless devices, as well as automotive and IoT applications.
about:
Qualcomm Technologies is headquartered in San Diego, California, and was founded in 1985. It operates as a subsidiary of Qualcomm Incorporated, handling substantially all engineering, research and development, and the QCT semiconductor business.

The company designs and supplies semiconductor products including mobile system-on-chips (SoCs), modems, and RF transceivers. Its capabilities span semiconductor design, RFIC and modem development, SoC integration, and on-device AI accelerator design. With a workforce of over 1,000 employees, Qualcomm develops platforms under the Snapdragon, Dragonwing, and Qualcomm Dragonfly brands for mobile, automotive, IoT, and data center markets.

Qualcomm serves industries such as mobile devices, automotive, IoT, data center, PC, extended reality (XR), wearables, audio, gaming, compute, and networking. Its customers include smartphone manufacturers, automotive OEMs, IoT device makers, and PC vendors building Copilot+ PCs powered by Windows on Snapdragon.

Qualcomm states that it "relentlessly innovates to deliver intelligent computing everywhere," emphasizing leading-edge AI, high-performance low-power computing, and unrivaled connectivity to transform major industries. The company positions itself as engineering human progress through developer-first AI solutions from edge to cloud, including the Qualcomm AI Hub and AI Stack.
